description: Establish and document the working baseline on fresh main (merged PR #1 standalone + PR #2 feedback). Confirm the build passes and separate pre-existing failures from any future regressions so later features are judged against a known-good starting point. No source changes in this feature.
steps: Confirm you are on branch main with PR #1 and PR #2 merged (git log --oneline -3 should show '#2' feedback and '#1' standalone). node_modules is already installed.

Run `npm test` and record the result. EXPECTED baseline: 179 pass / 16 fail. The 16 failures are pre-existing/environmental in scripts/**/*.test.mjs caused by missing .grok/skills/** directories (e.g. brand-check, write-atomic, og skill references) — NOT product bugs. Do not attempt to fix them.

Run the src-level suite directly: `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/lib/app-data/app-data.test.ts src/lib/auth/gate-identity.test.ts src/lib/feedback/feedback.test.ts` and confirm all 46 tests pass — this is the suite later features must keep green.

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and record the ~28 pre-existing typecheck errors (engine files: src/engine.ts, src/engine/audio.ts, src/engine/emitters.test.ts, src/physics.ts, src/webgpu-backend.ts, plus src/lib/feedback/pglite-glob-loader.mjs). These do NOT fail the vite build. Do not fix them; just record them so new type errors you introduce are distinguishable.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 (vite build + db:migrate skip + sync-dist).
Record all of the above (counts, which files, exit codes) in this feature's findings so later features and the final verification can subtract the pre-existing noise.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` shows exactly the pre-existing 16 scripts failures and 179 passes; the 46 src-level tests pass.
The pre-existing typecheck error set and the 16 environmental test failures are enumerated in findings.
